title: Charge type correct
description: Essential: Student identifies the ball's charge as positive, consistent with equilibrium in the given electric field direction.

title: Correct charge magnitude
description: Essential: Final answer for charge magnitude is derived as q = (mg tan α)/E.

title: Correct work expression
description: Essential: Final answer for work done by electric field is derived as W = mgl tan α.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: Solution correctly applies force balance (tension, gravity, electric force) to the ball at angle α.

title: Work from constant force
description: Important: Recognizes electric force is constant and calculates work as force times displacement in the force's direction.

title: Geometry for displacement
description: Important: Correctly identifies the horizontal displacement of the charge from release point to lowest point as l.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for work done (e.g., negative when it should be positive) based on direction of force and displacement.

title: Wrong force resolution
description: Pitfall: Misapplies trigonometry (e.g., uses sin/cos incorrectly) when resolving forces for the equilibrium condition.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Explicitly shows unit analysis confirming final expressions for charge and work have correct dimensions.
